donkey-kong-64-recompiled.note: Choose your own Donkey Kong 64 US 1.0 cartridge dump. Portcove checks the original and places it in the managed game folder. Select Play when setup is complete.

snap64-recomp.note: Choose your own unmodified USA Pokémon Snap cartridge dump. Portcove checks the original and installs the managed package for this device. Select Play when setup is complete.

linux-x86-64: The managed Linux package needs glibc 2.38 or newer, SDL2, GTK 3 and a Vulkan 1.2 driver.

Upstream reports testing on GitHub-hosted Macs only. Portcove has no native Mac execution result for this app.

quake-ironwail.note: Choose the id1 folder containing pak0.pak and pak1.pak from your own classic Quake installation. Portcove checks both PAKs and keeps its copies apart from saves and settings. Managed saves and settings stay under id1. Back up a separate upstream profile where applicable.
warnings: Use a separately prepared copy for the rerelease, expansions, mods, or custom base directories. Keep an existing manual installation and its data to continue using that copy.

linux-x86-64: The Linux player needs OpenGL 4.3, SDL2, libcurl, libvorbisfile and libmpg123.
